Alt-Lichtenberg — Berlin, Germany

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Alt-Lichtenberg is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Lichtenberg. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 15,842 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 5,487 cases recorded for the year, roughly 1.5× the citywide Bezirksregion average. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Alt-Lichtenberg safe?

Wandroz currently rates Alt-Lichtenberg in Berlin, Germany as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Alt-Lichtenberg safe at night?

At night, Alt-Lichtenberg is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Alt-Lichtenberg a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Alt-Lichtenberg's day rating (an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
